**Test image observations:** A mango leaf with scattered white/grayish powdery patches irregularly distributed across the green surface. The patches appear light-colored, dusty/powdery in texture, and cover portions of the upper leaf surface.

**Sooty Mould reference:** Shows dark blackish-brown sooty coating on leaves — clearly different from the white patches in the test image.

**Reasoning:** The test image shows characteristic **white powdery patches** scattered across the leaf surface — this is the hallmark of Powdery Mildew (*Oidium mangiferae*), which produces a white mealy/powdery fungal growth on mango leaves. Sooty Mould is dark/black, not white. Anthracnose produces dark lesions. The white dusty coating matches Powdery Mildew perfectly.
